versions.localizedDescription:
- 新增图片翻译：OCR 识别、气泡排版、背景修复、预翻译与自动翻译
- 新增 OCR 模型
- 拟声词默认不进入翻译，并收紧过滤规则
- 画廊语言与目标语言相同时跳过翻译
- 移除 Apple 风格界面，保留图片翻译能力
- 合并上游：修复下载任务重解析、优化滚动手势、支持 Archive Bot 重新采样压缩包

--------------------

- Add image translation: OCR, bubble layout, inpainting, pre-translate and auto-translate
- Add a new OCR model
- Skip onomatopoeia during translation and tighten filter rules
- Skip translation when the gallery language matches the target language
- Remove the Apple visual style while keeping image translation
- Merge upstream: fix download reparse, optimize scroll gestures, support Archive Bot resample
